user_query: My employer hasn’t paid my salary for 3 months. What can I do?
variations: Boss owes me salary. Where do I report?
How do I claim unpaid wages?
Company never paid me three months already
Who do I complain to if I don't get paid?
part_a_general_info: Under the Employment Act 1968 employers must pay salary within 7 days after the end of each salary period. If salary is unpaid you may file a claim with the Tripartite Alliance for Dispute Management (TADM). Claims must generally be filed within 1 year from the date salary was due or within 6 months of leaving employment. The Employment Claims Tribunals can hear claims up to $20,000 ($30,000 with union assistance). Mediation at TADM is mandatory before ECT.
triage_questions: Are you still working for the employer or have you left?
When was the last salary payment you received?
How much salary is owed in total?
Are you a Singapore Citizen PR or work permit holder?
Have you already filed a claim with TADM?
branching_logic: If employee left check whether claim falls within 6 month limitation
If work permit holder inform about MOM regulations
If already filed with TADM branch to ECT pathway
routing: No TADM claim refer to TADM mediation
TADM failed refer to ECT
Work permit holder refer to MOM and escalate
Time barred escalate to PBSG staff
guardrail: Do not advise on contractual entitlements or draft demand letters

user_query: I was fired unfairly. What can I do?
variations: My boss sacked me for no reason
I got terminated without warning
Is it legal for my company to fire me like this
I was dismissed and think it is wrongful
part_a_general_info: Wrongful dismissal occurs when an employee is dismissed without just cause or excuse under the Employment Act 1968. Claims must be filed with TADM within 1 month of dismissal. If mediation fails the matter may proceed to the Employment Claims Tribunals.
triage_questions: When were you dismissed?
Were you given a reason?
Were you given notice or salary in lieu?
Do you believe dismissal was discriminatory or to deprive benefits?
Have you filed with TADM already?
branching_logic: If dismissal occurred more than 1 month ago potentially time barred
If notice was given focus shifts to discrimination or retaliation
If discrimination suspected inform about TAFEP
routing: Within 1 month refer to TADM urgently
Discrimination element refer to TADM and TAFEP
TADM failed refer to ECT
Time barred escalate to PBSG staff
guardrail: Do not determine whether dismissal is justified

topic: Employment Law — Freelancer or Gig Worker
user_query: I'm a freelancer and my client will not pay me. Can I go to TADM?
variations: I do delivery and they owe me money
My contract work client has not paid
I am self employed can I claim salary
Platform company owes me payment
part_a_general_info: Freelancers under a contract for service are generally not covered by the Employment Act. They usually cannot file claims at TADM or ECT. Payment disputes may go to the Small Claims Tribunal up to $20,000 or Magistrates Court up to $60,000. Mediation and a letter of demand are recommended first.
triage_questions: Describe the working arrangement
Do you have a written contract
Are you a platform worker or association member
How much money is owed
branching_logic: If relationship appears like employment escalate for misclassification
If platform worker refer to platform association
If amount less than or equal to $20k go to SCT otherwise Magistrates Court
routing: Freelancer less than or equal to $20k refer to Small Claims Tribunal
Freelancer above $20k refer to Magistrates or District Court
Possible employee misclassification escalate to PBSG staff
Platform worker refer to platform association
guardrail: Do not determine employee versus freelancer status

user_query: I was injured at work. My boss will not pay medical bills.

Work accident who pays

part_a_general_info: Under the Work Injury Compensation Act employers must compensate employees for work injuries regardless of fault. Compensation covers medical expenses and medical leave wages. Claims are generally filed with the Ministry of Manpower.

What injuries were suffered and was medical treatment received
Has employer filed an incident report with MOM
How long was medical leave
Are you a Singapore Citizen PR or foreign worker
branching_logic: If employer did not report incident worker may report to MOM directly
If foreign worker additional protections may apply
If serious injury worker may consider legal advice
routing: Standard claim refer to MOM WICA filing
Employer non cooperation advise worker to report to MOM
Foreign worker refer to Migrant Workers Centre
Serious injury escalate to PBSG staff
guardrail: Do not advise whether to pursue WICA or common law claims

topic: Employment Law — Non Payment of CPF
user_query: My company did not pay my CPF
variations: Employer not contributing CPF
Boss never top up CPF
How to check if CPF was paid
Company owes CPF contributions
part_a_general_info: Under the Central Provident Fund Act employers must contribute CPF for Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents. Failure to do so is a criminal offence and complaints can be lodged with the CPF Board.
triage_questions: How long has CPF not been contributed
Have you checked CPF statements
Are you a Singapore Citizen or PR
Are you still employed with the company
branching_logic: If not SC or PR CPF usually not required
If still employed advise caution as complaint may affect employment relationship
routing: Confirmed non payment refer to CPF Board
If not resident explain CPF not required
If employee left refer to CPF Board and possibly TADM

user_query: My boss refuses to pay me overtime
variations: I worked extra hours but got no money
Is overtime pay mandatory
Company says no overtime for my role
Claiming money for working weekends or public holidays
part_a_general_info: Under Part IV of the Employment Act overtime pay applies mainly to workmen earning up to $4500 per month and non workmen earning up to $2600 per month. Covered employees must receive overtime at 1.5 times their hourly rate.
triage_questions: What is your job role
What is your monthly salary
Does your contract mention overtime pay
Are you Singapore Citizen PR or work permit holder
branching_logic: If manager or salary above threshold statutory overtime may not apply
If work permit holder refer to MOM or TADM
routing: Covered under Part IV file claim with TADM
If not covered and contract silent refer to PBSG employment clinic
If contract includes overtime but unpaid file claim at TADM
guardrail: Do not calculate overtime owed or interpret ambiguous contract clauses
